title: The onboarding funnel event can undercount when a grid weight save and the onboarding end land in the same render as another state change
evidence: From PR 1579 review F2. widget-src/src/hooks/useOnboarding.ts:176-193: the layout effect sets rec.counted = rec.reached on every pass, then sends onboarding_step (line 186) and onboarding_done (line 189) only if rec.reached grew and rec.answered is set. If the weight saves from the grid and the onboarding ends in a render batched with another state change, the step can be counted without its event. Narrow window, reasoned from code, not seen live. Write a failing pin for that order first, then fix. (H94)
